channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: Lady Chargers stifled by Patriots in NCCSA 2-A final
item.description: Defending champ Wilmington Christian shut down Wilson Christian 36-12 in the NCCSA 2-A girls final, holding the Lady Chargers to a season-low in a rematch of last year’s title game.

item.title: Partnerships support recovery initiatives
item.description: Wilson County Substance Prevention Coalition is expanding partnerships with state leaders, businesses and youth to strengthen recovery services, harm reduction and overdose response training.

item.title: Cyclones get revenge, MACAA three-peat over Faith Christian
item.description: Community Christian avenged its lone MACAA loss, beating Faith Christian 59-53 at Campbell for a third straight MACAA 2-A title, led by MVP Jack Beamon's 18 points and 10 rebounds.

item.title: Greenfield hosts community STEM Night next week
item.description: Greenfield School hosts a free community STEM Night March 4, 6–8 p.m., featuring hands-on science, technology, engineering and math exhibits for all ages.

item.title: Accidental house fire damages kitchen
item.description: Accidental kitchen fire causes $20,000 in property damage and content at Wilson home; no injuries reported

item.title: Utility portal outage causes payment issues
item.description: A nationwide outage from payment vendor BridgePay has left Wilson’s MyWilson utility portal unable to process online and autopay bills for weeks, causing payment delays.

item.title: New jargon overheard in the teachers’ lounge
item.description: From “AI instructional slop” to “Six Seven,” new jargon in education reflects shifting ideas about neuroscience, absenteeism, dual language programs, technology, grading and alternatives to traditional college.

item.title: Trump has new ‘commandments’ for MAGA — and everyone else, too
item.description: An author argues Trump has replaced the Ten Commandments with a new authoritarian code that glorifies greed, repression and aristocratic power.

item.title: Tariff refunds: Honest policy would be smart politics
item.description: After Supreme Court curbs Trump's tariff powers, an op-ed says refunding importers would be both honest policy and a rare political lifeline for Republicans before the midterms.

item.title: Judge rules courtroom is no place for Carrboro’s climate complaint
item.description: NC judge tosses Carrboro’s climate lawsuit against Duke Energy, saying disputes over emissions, climate damage and state energy policy belong to lawmakers and regulators, not the courts.
